newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak BSE fall continues, SAX down 3.62 pts.
newsitem.headline: Slovak BSE fall continues, SAX down 3.62 pts.

text.p: Slovak shares were quiet in listless trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday, with fall in several blue chips pulling the 16-share SAX index down 3.62 points to 174.05.
Drug producer Slovakofarma, which pushed the SAX slightly higher on Monday, retreated 414 crowns to 4,000 on Tuesday, with only 14 traded shares.
Oil refiner Slovnaft closed unchanged at 850 crowns, but with its average price -- on which the SAX is calculated -- falling by 0.7 percent.
Brokers said the bourse's downtrend showed no signs of letting up, with domestic investors extremely quiet at the moment.

"On the other hand, foreign investors are partially expecting devaluation of the crown and partially betting on further decline of the share prices. This results in their cautious and wait-and-see attitude," said Libor Briska of Creditanstalt.
Trading on the floor was dominated by steel maker VSZ, with 313 traded shares and closing price at 625 crowns, four crowns higher from Monday.
Overall, volume fell to 330,351 shares, from 580,342 on Monday, while turnover eased to 146.19 million crowns, from 178.05 million.
